goal: Explain why a zero timeout is selected and identify a bounded repair.
expected: An omitted timeout should keep the documented default.
environment: Local repository checkout; no service or production access.

hypotheses.claim: The loader replaces an omitted timeout with zero.
hypotheses.falsifier: The loader explicitly preserves the documented default.

hypotheses.claim: A supplied configuration explicitly sets zero.
hypotheses.falsifier: The configuration contains no explicit timeout.

actions.purpose: Check whether zero is explicitly configured.
Locate the timeout default and override path.
Identify adjacent configuration modules by name.
